definition.simple: A substance made when two or more different elements chemically join together.
definition.academic: A pure substance composed of two or more different elements chemically bonded in fixed proportions by mass.

common_misconceptions: Thinking a compound keeps the properties of its elements. (e.g., Sodium is explosive, Chlorine is toxic, but NaCl is edible salt).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Do the properties change when elements form a compound? Think about what makes up water.
